text: Attempt 6 begins. Every loan must pay for itself: loans only for districts that fill (~5,000 people each), infrastructure from cash, the loan guard never overridden except for fires, taxes 7% with the controller between 6 and 10, cash kept positive so fires can be fought. Fire rules from attempt 5 kept.

Attempt 6 started. Attempt 5 survived fires for 46 years but went broke, then lost 80% of the city to a 2048 fire it couldn't afford to fight. New rule: a loan must bring about 5,000 people or I don't take it.
Feb 2001: loan #2 for the 2003 district (homes + jobs).
Jun 2002: loans #3-4: coal plant + 19 north pumps, second coal plant + north job district.
Tax controller: shops 7 -> 8 (demand 1902), factories 7 -> 8 (demand 2000)
Feb 2003: zoo from cash (home demand -618); finance ordinances + City Beautification.
Tax controller: homes 7 -> 6 (demand -640), shops 8 -> 9 (demand 1576), factories 8 -> 9 (demand 2000)
Tax controller: factories 9 -> 10 (demand 1811)
Jul 2004: south pumps powered (line joined at 77,77); loan #5 for the seaport + east job strip; airport from cash in the north-east, one row in from the map edge, line through it, own fire station.

Jul 2005: loan #6: dense homes along the east edge facing the job strip (its trips failed), district 5 (homes + factories, no parks). Two road tiles of x76 at y77-78 stay power lines; the network is still joined.
Tax controller: shops 9 -> 8 (demand -750)
Jun 2006: loan #7 for the stadium beside the zoo (home demand at zero: the recreation cap); 4 fire stations from cash.
Feb 2007: coal plant on its own in the east from cash (power 7% spare).
20,350 people in early 2007, about 5,000 ahead of attempt 5. Seven loans so far, each one for something that brings people. Power plant paid from cash.

Dec 2007: loan #8 (passed the guard): dense factory + home block by the seaport, south mixed district (factories between home cells); power join for its west homes below road y109; fire station by the east coal plant.
Dec 2008: road links to the east and south edges and a second seaport from cash; seaport roads rerouted around two fire stations (y55, and a road at 63,53).
Tax controller: shops 8 -> 9 (demand 1409)
Tax controller: shops 9 -> 8 (demand 1566), factories 10 -> 8 (demand 1609)
Tax controller: shops 8 -> 9 (demand 1566), factories 8 -> 10 (demand 1609)
Jul-Dec 2009: water ran to 0% spare: 14 mid riverbank pumps from cash; zoo #2 from cash (home demand at zero).
Dec 2009: loan #10 for the south band (shops, factories, homes); south-east coal plant + fire station from cash (power 13% spare).
Tax controller: shops 9 -> 10 (demand 1471)
Tax controller: homes 6 -> 8 (demand 940), shops 10 -> 8 (demand -400)
Feb 2011: loan #11 for the south-west band below the lakes (homes, shops); 7 lake-shore pumps + pipe y109 for its water; home tax 6 -> 8.
Tax controller: shops 8 -> 7 (demand -771)
Tax controller: shops 7 -> 6 (demand -1201), factories 10 -> 8 (demand 41)

CONTROL: c4a5-westblock was refused in Dec 2007 (its factory cell overlapped a fire station) and I only read the last lines of the build output, so the block sat unbuilt until Jul 2013. Fixed: seq.sh now ends with 'SEQ NOT CLEAN' naming any plan that did not finish 'BUILD: checked'.
Jul 2013: 12 pond pumps by the zoo (water 7% spare); the west factory + home block built at last (trimmed to x72); shops 6%, factories 8% (shop demand -1,201).

Jul 2015: loan #12 (passed the guard): crossed the river - bridge road y69 + raised wires y70, west district x20-40 y48-69 (homes, shops, factories, no parks), road link to the WEST edge at (0,69), 11 west-lake pumps + 8 river-shore pumps.
Mid-2015, 39,700 people: crossed the river to the empty west bank with a bridge, a new district and a fourth road link to a neighbouring city, which should lift the cap on shops.
Nov 2015: loan #13 (guard passed) for a coal plant on its own in the south-west with a fire station (power 8% spare).
Jul 2017: loan #14 (guard passed): second west district x20-40 y27-47 (homes, shops, factories) + 11 riverbank pumps.
Tax controller: shops 6 -> 7 (demand 1071)
Tax controller: homes 8 -> 9 (demand 801), shops 7 -> 8 (demand 1265)
Feb 2018: three dense shop cells x21-39 y21-26 on the west bank from cash; taxes homes 9 / shops 8 / factories 8.
Tax controller: shops 8 -> 9 (demand 1509)

Dec 2018: loan #15 (guard passed) for a north-west coal plant + fire station on the west bank; west strip x10-19 y28-61 (factories, shops, homes) from cash; a stray autocal bridge over the west lake could not be bulldozed, so it was joined to road x13.
Tax controller: shops 9 -> 10 (demand 1290)
Tax controller: shops 10 -> 9 (demand -1017)
Feb 2021: loan #16 (guard passed): south-west bank grid x6-27 y70-90, 9 cells with factories next to homes.
57,600 people in early 2021, the best Claudeville 4 city so far at this date, and no fires yet. Now building on the big empty south-west bank. Shops are capped again, the next problem to crack.
Tax controller: shops 9 -> 8 (demand -1089), factories 8 -> 9 (demand 1009)
Tax controller: shops 8 -> 7 (demand -769)
Sep 2022: south-west coal plant + fire station and 5 lake pumps from cash (power 8%, water 12% spare).
Dec 2023: cash fell below zero; loan #17 (guard passed) for shops + homes x7-19 y91-103 on the south-west bank (shop demand 1,268).
Tax controller: shops 7 -> 8 (demand 1454)
Tax controller: shops 8 -> 9 (demand 1941)
Tax controller: shops 9 -> 10 (demand 1893), factories 9 -> 7 (demand -380)

Dec 2024: loan #18 (guard passed): 8 cells of shops and homes x28-47 y84-103 + stadium #2 on the south-west bank; road x27 y93-95 left out (fire station); pipe for the middle shop cell. Taxes homes 9 / shops 10 / factories 7.
Tax controller: factories 7 -> 6 (demand -327)
Feb 2026: 12 pumps on the south-west river bank from cash (water 9% spare). 75,760 people: a Claudeville 4 record.
75,760 people in early 2026: a new Claudeville 4 record (attempt 4 peaked at 74,150), with no great fire and the budget only ~$1,500 a year short.
Feb 2027: loan #19 (guard passed): 12 cells x7-47 y105-117 on the far south-west (mostly dense homes); 5 fire stations from cash (fire cover WARN cleared).
Jul 2027: loan #20 (guard passed) for a coal plant + fire station in the far south-west corner (power 8% spare).
Tax controller: homes 9 -> 10 (demand 1132), shops 10 -> 9 (demand -973)
Sep 2028: three dense factory cells x49-54 y84-103 by the river on the south-west bank, from cash (factory demand 1,032).
Tax controller: factories 6 -> 7 (demand 1603)
Tax controller: factories 7 -> 8 (demand 1683)
Tax controller: homes 10 -> 9 (demand -220), shops 9 -> 10 (demand 1035), factories 8 -> 9 (demand 1618)
Jan 2030: loan #21 (guard passed): marina on the south river (home demand -220), three dense shop cells x21-39 y13-19 in the north-west; taxes 9/10/9.
Tax controller: factories 9 -> 10 (demand 1188)
Feb 2031: zoo #3 below the far south-west homes from cash (home demand ~0).

91,900 people in early 2031, the first Claudeville 4 city past 90,000 this early, still with no great fire. Shops and factories keep asking for land; homes need more parks, zoos and marinas to keep growing.
